title: Update 21.1 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2022 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 21.1 for Business Central 2022 Release Wave 2 introduces feature changes including Microsoft 365 license access, Teams embedding, auto-save capability, expanded localization support, and SharePoint integration along with regulatory updates for Belgium, United States, and Netherlands.
features: Access Business Central with Microsoft 365 license
Embed Business Central in Teams tabs
Multiline text fields with Word mail merge
User sync based on environment security groups
